title: Butter from cream
method: Put all the cream in a food processor and use the setting 1 (of 2) to whisk the butter.
Keep it going for 5 minutes (or maybe a bit more if needed) until there is definite solid butter and molky buttermilk.
Strain of the buttermilk and use for baking.
Wash the butter in cold water.
Dry as best you can and then add salt. Mix very well.
Form into a block and refrigerate.
